def transform(grid):
    # Extract connected panels (8-neighborhood), compare their occupied masks.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
          st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
          while st:
            y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy in (-1,0,1):
              for dx in (-1,0,1):
                q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                  seen.add(q); st.append(q)
          comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    a,b=comps[:2]
    def norm(comp):
      y0=min(y for y,x in comp); x0=min(x for y,x in comp); y1=max(y for y,x in comp); x1=max(x for y,x in comp)
      return {(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in comp}, y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
    A,ah,aw=norm(a); B,bh,bw=norm(b)
    mask={(y,x) for y in range(max(ah,bh)) for x in range(max(aw,bw)) if ((y,x) in A)!=((y,x) in B)}
    if not mask: return [[0]]
    y0=min(y for y,x in mask); y1=max(y for y,x in mask); x0=min(x for y,x in mask); x1=max(x for y,x in mask)
    return [[8 if (y,x) in mask else 0 for x in range(x0,x1+1)] for y in range(y0,y1+1)]
